checks: Twelve authored levels, three themes,153 finite fruits and deterministic waves
Quadratic sweep detects high-speed crossings, tangencies and starts inside, rejects misses
Ready refuses physics and cutting; start advances no simulated time or score
Unknown, nonfinite and outside initial pointers cannot write resources or create a stroke
Fixed-step trajectories match analytic gravity and authored wind at normal simulation time
Equivalent frame subdivisions produce identical physics with no time-scale adjustment
Clicking a natural flying fruit without dragging gives no score
Tiny jitter and stationary movement do not auto-collect a fruit
A fast200-pixel drag across a real fruit cuts once even with no intermediate points
Relative sweep follows a target moving between pointer samples
Repeated sweeps over the same target never duplicate cut IDs or points
A stale sample reanchors rather than teleport-slicing across elapsed time
Cancel/up invalidate the old stroke; duplicate down/up or ghost moves do not score
Outward high-speed motion clips the real in-field segment then cancels the old stroke
One stroke builds genuine three-target combos and awards separate base/bonus points
Separate short strokes can cut every fruit yet fail the unchanged combo goal
A natural thorn hit consumes one shared error, gives no points and cannot damage twice
Three ordinary thorn hits settle failure immediately without later same-segment charges
Uncut fruits escaping the screen count once, hazards escaping cause no error
Simultaneous misses stop at the error limit rather than overcharging the finished game
No early victory before all waves; real completion only settles once
Pause cancels a live gesture and neither elapsed wall time nor ghost moves can score
A long frame is bounded to0.1second and excess time is discarded rather than banked
Ready and running checkpoints replay physics and resources exactly, then resume paused without gestures
Malformed/timestamp-invalid checkpoints reject and forged scores/resources are ignored
All12 normal1x physics campaigns replay exact actual trajectories and target resources
Snapshots and checkpoint logs cannot mutate live targets, score or stroke history
fixture: Abstract geometric points are used only for sweep-math unit cases. All game cuts, combos, dangers, misses, goals and settlements use ordinary trajectories on formal levels, never direct score/resource/result writes.
